description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientStreamingProviderRuntime class, which manages stream provider runtime logic including stream directory handling, pub/sub modes, lifecycle participation, and extension binding within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ClientStreamingProviderRuntime
classes.description: An internal class implementing streaming runtime management, including pub/sub modes, lifecycle participation, stream directory management, and extension binding within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: ClientStreamingProviderRuntime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the streaming provider runtime with necessary dependencies and setting up pub/sub components.

methods.name: GetStreamDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current stream directory instance.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream directory, optionally performing cleanup.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Returns the identity of the current runtime client activation.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds a new extension instance and returns its tuple with interface type.

methods.name: PubSub
methods.description: Returns the appropriate pub/sub implementation based on the specified pub/sub type.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the runtime to the cluster client lifecycle events, particularly for initialization and reset.
